[[Quansong's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus]] dropped by [[Quansong Spiritspeak]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Tahnnakai Temple (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Communing]])
:[[Communing]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])
:[[Health]] +30
